title: BRAin metastases treated with INSTAnt application of intraoperative RadioTherapy – a multicenter observational study
summary: The aim of this study is to set up a registry collecting the clinical courses of patients who received radiation treatment directly during surgery (intraoperative radiotherapy, IORT) as part of a planned operation to remove a brain metastasis. Data are collected retrospectively (looking back at past cases) from multiple centers. In an additional, optional step, the outcomes of these patients will be compared with those of patients who instead received external beam radiotherapy (EBRT). Leading European centers with particular experience in performing intraoperative radiotherapy for brain metastases are participating as partners. The BRAINSTART registry aims to gather high-quality data to better assess the effectiveness and survival outcomes of this treatment across multiple centers, thereby laying the groundwork for future randomized clinical trials on this topic.
conditions: Secondary malignant neoplasm of brain and cerebral meninges

interventions.name: Retrospective, multicenter analysis of all patients who received intraoperative radiation therapy for brain metastases as adjuvant treatment from first presentation to neurosurgery until loss to follow up or death

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with histologically confirmed cerebral metastases
Resection of the investigated lesion
Adjuvant treatment of the lesion with IORT or EBRT
Exclusion criteria:
none
